messages:
elena (support): Customer reports promo code accepted in UI and confirmation email, but account balance remains 0.0. Customer ID org_8f3b, claim id claim_8271. Promo=WELCOME2026. :confused:

samir (billing): Thanks — can you paste the webhook receipt / any logs? also which environment (prod/staging)?

elena (support): Prod. UI shows the green check and email arrived at 2026-03-10T14:23Z. Webhook callback returned 200 per customer. Payload they sent:

```json
{
  "claim_id": "claim_8271",
  "org_id": "org_8f3b",
  "promo": "WELCOME2026",
  "credits": 1000,
  "status": "applied"
}
```

webhook-bot: Delivered POST /hooks/promo -> payments-service 200 OK (req=rm_61a2) :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Logged ticket SUP-4729 and linked ledger check. Suggested quick checks: billing_profile exists, tenant mapping, duplicate-key in ledger upsert.

samir (billing): I pulled logs for claim_8271. payments-service forwarded to billing-connector but billing-connector responded with 409 duplicate_key for ledger insert. snippet:

```
ERROR billing-connector: UpsertLedger failed for org=org_8f3b claim=claim_8271 error=409 duplicate_key (ledger.entries.claim_id)
```

samir (billing): That 409 should still be idempotent, but I don't see a corresponding ledger row for this claim. looks like a partial failure: transaction aborted before write. I'll run a reprocess for rm_61a2 and re-run ledger ingestion.

maria-payments: tagging in. I'll reprocess webhook RM ID rm_61a2 with safe-retry; will also run `select * from ledger_entries where claim_id='claim_8271'` to confirm. ETA ~15m. :eyes:

elena (support): Please confirm before messaging customer. They are on a trial and anxious.

maria-payments: Reprocessed. Reingest job log:

```
INFO reingest: starting rm_61a2 -> invoking billing-connector
INFO billing-connector: creating ledger entry claim=claim_8271 org=org_8f3b amount=1000
INFO ledger-service: insert ok id=le_992b
```

maria-payments: Ledger entry created le_992b, account balance updated +1000 credits. Notified customer at 2026-03-10T14:40Z. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:

elena (support): Thanks team — closing on our side. I'll follow up if customer still sees UI cache issues. :thumbsup:
